lineage.strategy: Acquire a current primary commercial-channel signal materially different from Q2 financials.

observations.fact: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner, with planned integration of Nebius compute and inference endpoints inside the Palantir enterprise perimeter for eligible customers.
The companies state they will work together to bring new AI capacity online faster, creating a distribution/channel path beyond Nebius direct cloud sales.

risks.risk: Preferred-partner status and technical integration do not establish committed revenue, utilization, margin or customer conversion.

unknowns.unknown: No contract value, minimum capacity commitment, revenue-sharing economics or adoption schedule is disclosed.

recommendation: Use as current channel/bottleneck evidence, but do not convert partnership language into revenue or numeric catalyst value without contract economics.
